SELECT a.attname,
  pg_catalog.format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod),
  (SELECT pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(d.adbin, d.adrelid, true)
   FROM pg_catalog.pg_attrdef d
   WHERE d.adrelid = a.attrelid AND d.adnum = a.attnum AND a.atthasdef),
  a.attnotnull,
  (SELECT c.collname FROM pg_catalog.pg_collation c, pg_catalog.pg_type t
   WHERE c.oid = a.attcollation AND t.oid = a.atttypid AND a.attcollation <> t.typcollation) AS attcollation,
  a.attidentity,
  a.attgenerated,
  a.attstorage,
  CASE WHEN a.attstattarget=-1 THEN NULL ELSE a.attstattarget END AS attstattarget,
  pg_catalog.col_description(a.attrelid, a.attnum)
FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute a
WHERE a.attrelid = '22251' AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped
ORDER BY a.attnum
;
SELECT c.oid::pg_catalog.regclass, c.relkind, inhdetachpending, pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(c.relpartbound, c.oid)
FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c, pg_catalog.pg_inherits i
WHERE c.oid = i.inhrelid AND i.inhparent = '26720'
ORDER BY pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(c.relpartbound, c.oid) = 'DEFAULT', c.oid::pg_catalog.regclass::pg_catalog.text
;
SELECT oid, stxrelid::pg_catalog.regclass, stxnamespace::pg_catalog.regnamespace::pg_catalog.text AS nsp, stxname,
pg_catalog.pg_get_statisticsobjdef_columns(oid) AS columns,
  'd' = any(stxkind) AS ndist_enabled,
  'f' = any(stxkind) AS deps_enabled,
  'm' = any(stxkind) AS mcv_enabled,
stxstattarget
FROM pg_catalog.pg_statistic_ext
WHERE stxrelid = '30955'
ORDER BY nsp, stxname
;
SELECT pubname
     , NULL
     , NULL
FROM pg_catalog.pg_publication p
     JOIN pg_catalog.pg_publication_namespace pn ON p.oid = pn.pnpubid
     JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class pc ON pc.relnamespace = pn.pnnspid
WHERE pc.oid ='27192' and pg_catalog.pg_relation_is_publishable('27192')
UNION
SELECT pubname
     , pg_get_expr(pr.prqual, c.oid)
     , (CASE WHEN pr.prattrs IS NOT NULL THEN
         (SELECT string_agg(attname, ', ')
           FROM pg_catalog.generate_series(0, pg_catalog.array_upper(pr.prattrs::pg_catalog.int2[], 1)) s,
                pg_catalog.pg_attribute
          WHERE attrelid = pr.prrelid AND attnum = prattrs[s])
        ELSE NULL END) FROM pg_catalog.pg_publication p
     JOIN pg_catalog.pg_publication_rel pr ON p.oid = pr.prpubid
     JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class c ON c.oid = pr.prrelid
WHERE pr.prrelid = '27192'
UNION
SELECT pubname
     , NULL
     , NULL
FROM pg_catalog.pg_publication p
WHERE p.puballtables AND pg_catalog.pg_relation_is_publishable('27192')
ORDER BY 1
;
SELECT a.attname,
  pg_catalog.format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod),
  (SELECT pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(d.adbin, d.adrelid, true)
   FROM pg_catalog.pg_attrdef d
   WHERE d.adrelid = a.attrelid AND d.adnum = a.attnum AND a.atthasdef),
  a.attnotnull,
  (SELECT c.collname FROM pg_catalog.pg_collation c, pg_catalog.pg_type t
   WHERE c.oid = a.attcollation AND t.oid = a.atttypid AND a.attcollation <> t.typcollation) AS attcollation,
  a.attidentity,
  a.attgenerated,
  a.attstorage,
  CASE WHEN a.attstattarget=-1 THEN NULL ELSE a.attstattarget END AS attstattarget,
  pg_catalog.col_description(a.attrelid, a.attnum)
FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute a
WHERE a.attrelid = '29436' AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped
ORDER BY a.attnum
;
SELECT '0/17D8A08' <= replay_lsn AND state = 'streaming'
         FROM pg_catalog.pg_stat_replication
         WHERE application_name IN ('tap_sub_B', 'walreceiver')
;
SELECT oid, stxrelid::pg_catalog.regclass, stxnamespace::pg_catalog.regnamespace::pg_catalog.text AS nsp, stxname,
pg_catalog.pg_get_statisticsobjdef_columns(oid) AS columns,
  'd' = any(stxkind) AS ndist_enabled,
  'f' = any(stxkind) AS deps_enabled,
  'm' = any(stxkind) AS mcv_enabled,
stxstattarget
FROM pg_catalog.pg_statistic_ext
WHERE stxrelid = '22493'
ORDER BY nsp, stxname
;
SELECT a.attname,
  pg_catalog.format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod),
  CASE WHEN a.attnum <= (SELECT i.indnkeyatts FROM pg_catalog.pg_index i WHERE i.indexrelid = '42457') THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS is_key,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_indexdef(a.attrelid, a.attnum, TRUE) AS indexdef
FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute a
WHERE a.attrelid = '42457' AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped
ORDER BY a.attnum
;
SELECT c.oid::pg_catalog.regclass, c.relkind, inhdetachpending, pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(c.relpartbound, c.oid)
FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c, pg_catalog.pg_inherits i
WHERE c.oid = i.inhrelid AND i.inhparent = '37084'
ORDER BY pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(c.relpartbound, c.oid) = 'DEFAULT', c.oid::pg_catalog.regclass::pg_catalog.text
;
SELECT a.attname,
  pg_catalog.format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod),
  CASE WHEN a.attnum <= (SELECT i.indnkeyatts FROM pg_catalog.pg_index i WHERE i.indexrelid = '42470') THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS is_key,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_indexdef(a.attrelid, a.attnum, TRUE) AS indexdef
FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute a
WHERE a.attrelid = '42470' AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped
ORDER BY a.attnum
;
SELECT "amcheck_schema".bt_index_check(index := c.oid, heapallindexed := false)
FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c, pg_catalog.pg_index i WHERE c.oid = 2672 AND c.oid = i.indexrelid AND c.relpersistence != 't' AND i.indisready AND i.indisvalid AND i.indislive
;
-- JSON_VALUE
SELECT JSON_VALUE(NULL::jsonb, '$')
;
-- For binary upgrade, must preserve pg_type array oid
SELECT pg_catalog.binary_upgrade_set_next_array_pg_type_oid('19399'::pg_catalog.oid)
;
SELECT t.tgname, pg_catalog.pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid, true), t.tgenabled, t.tgisinternal,
  CASE WHEN t.tgparentid != 0 THEN
    (SELECT u.tgrelid::pg_catalog.regclass
     FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger AS u,
          pg_catalog.pg_partition_ancestors(t.tgrelid) WITH ORDINALITY AS a(relid, depth)
     WHERE u.tgname = t.tgname AND u.tgrelid = a.relid
           AND u.tgparentid = 0
     ORDER BY a.depth LIMIT 1)
  END AS parent
FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger t
WHERE t.tgrelid = '36670' AND (NOT t.tgisinternal OR (t.tgisinternal AND t.tgenabled = 'D'))
ORDER BY 1
;
SELECT sum(unique1) over (partition by ten
	order by four groups between 0 preceding and 0 following exclude group), unique1, four, ten
FROM tenk1 WHERE unique1 < 10
;
-- For binary upgrade, must preserve pg_type oid
SELECT pg_catalog.binary_upgrade_set_next_pg_type_oid('28853'::pg_catalog.oid)
;
SELECT a.attname,
  pg_catalog.format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod),
  (SELECT pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(d.adbin, d.adrelid, true)
   FROM pg_catalog.pg_attrdef d
   WHERE d.adrelid = a.attrelid AND d.adnum = a.attnum AND a.atthasdef),
  a.attnotnull,
  (SELECT c.collname FROM pg_catalog.pg_collation c, pg_catalog.pg_type t
   WHERE c.oid = a.attcollation AND t.oid = a.atttypid AND a.attcollation <> t.typcollation) AS attcollation,
  a.attidentity,
  a.attgenerated,
  a.attstorage,
  CASE WHEN a.attstattarget=-1 THEN NULL ELSE a.attstattarget END AS attstattarget,
  pg_catalog.col_description(a.attrelid, a.attnum)
FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute a
WHERE a.attrelid = '29865' AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped
ORDER BY a.attnum
;
select '{"a": {"b":{"c": "foo"}}}'::json #> array['a','b','c','d']
;
SELECT d AS date, i AS interval,
       eval(format('date %L + interval %L', d, i)) AS plus,
       eval(format('date %L - interval %L', d, i)) AS minus
FROM (VALUES (date '-infinity'),
             (date '1995-08-06'),
             (date 'infinity')) AS t1(d),
     (VALUES (interval '-infinity'),
             (interval 'infinity')) AS t2(i)
;
SELECT pg_catalog.binary_upgrade_set_next_heap_pg_class_oid('34544'::pg_catalog.oid)
;
SELECT c.reltype AS crel, t.reltype AS trel FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class t ON   (c.reltoastrelid = t.oid AND c.relkind <> 'p') WHERE c.oid = '36288'::pg_catalog.oid
;
EXPLAIN SELECT array_agg(ctid) FROM brintest_multi WHERE int2col >= '0'::int4
;

SELECT pg_catalog.binary_upgrade_set_next_heap_pg_class_oid('36731'::pg_catalog.oid)

SELECT c.oid::pg_catalog.regclass
FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c, pg_catalog.pg_inherits i
WHERE c.oid = i.inhparent AND i.inhrelid = '31479'
  AND c.relkind != 'p' AND c.relkind != 'I'
ORDER BY inhseqno
;
-- Don't remove SJ
EXPLAIN (COSTS OFF)
SELECT * FROM sj j1, sj j2 WHERE j1.b = j2.b AND (j1.a = 1 OR j2.a = 1)
;
SELECT conname, conrelid::pg_catalog.regclass AS ontable,
       pg_catalog.pg_get_constraintdef(oid, true) AS condef
  FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint c
 WHERE confrelid IN (SELECT pg_catalog.pg_partition_ancestors('18137')
                     UNION ALL VALUES ('18137'::pg_catalog.regclass))
       AND contype = 'f' AND conparentid = 0
ORDER BY conname
;
SELECT '42'::int_custom < '100'::int_custom AS lt_test
;
SELECT pg_catalog.binary_upgrade_set_next_index_relfilenode('38803'::pg_catalog.oid)
;
SELECT pg_catalog.binary_upgrade_set_next_toast_relfilenode('34346'::pg_catalog.oid)
;
SELECT pg_catalog.pg_relation_size('public.loct2'::pg_catalog.regclass) / 8192
;
SELECT conname, conrelid::pg_catalog.regclass AS ontable,
       pg_catalog.pg_get_constraintdef(oid, true) AS condef
  FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint c
 WHERE confrelid IN (SELECT pg_catalog.pg_partition_ancestors('35412')
                     UNION ALL VALUES ('35412'::pg_catalog.regclass))
       AND contype = 'f' AND conparentid = 0
ORDER BY conname
;
SELECT c.relchecks, c.relkind, c.relhasindex, c.relhasrules, c.relhastriggers, c.relrowsecurity, c.relforcerowsecurity, false AS relhasoids, c.relispartition, '', c.reltablespace, CASE WHEN c.reloftype = 0 THEN '' ELSE c.reloftype::pg_catalog.regtype::pg_catalog.text END, c.relpersistence, c.relreplident, am.amname
FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c
 LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class tc ON (c.reltoastrelid = tc.oid)
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_am am ON (c.relam = am.oid)
WHERE c.oid = '30704'
;
select 'bbc' ~ '^([bc])\1*$' as f
;
SELECT typarray FROM pg_catalog.pg_type WHERE oid = '35672'::pg_catalog.oid
;
SELECT a.attname,
  pg_catalog.format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod),
  (SELECT pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(d.adbin, d.adrelid, true)
   FROM pg_catalog.pg_attrdef d
   WHERE d.adrelid = a.attrelid AND d.adnum = a.attnum AND a.atthasdef),
  a.attnotnull,
  (SELECT c.collname FROM pg_catalog.pg_collation c, pg_catalog.pg_type t
   WHERE c.oid = a.attcollation AND t.oid = a.atttypid AND a.attcollation <> t.typcollation) AS attcollation,
  a.attidentity,
  a.attgenerated
FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute a
WHERE a.attrelid = '46215' AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped
ORDER BY a.attnum
;
SELECT count(*) FROM tbl_cs_fail
;
-- For binary upgrade, must preserve pg_type oid
SELECT pg_catalog.binary_upgrade_set_next_pg_type_oid('35055'::pg_catalog.oid)
;
SELECT a.attname,
  pg_catalog.format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod),
  CASE WHEN a.attnum <= (SELECT i.indnkeyatts FROM pg_catalog.pg_index i WHERE i.indexrelid = '16533') THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS is_key,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_indexdef(a.attrelid, a.attnum, TRUE) AS indexdef
FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute a
WHERE a.attrelid = '16533' AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped
ORDER BY a.attnum
;
SELECT LOWER(name) as aba FROM srt WHERE name = 'ABA'
;
SELECT '0/14A8150' <= replay_lsn AND state = 'streaming'
         FROM pg_catalog.pg_stat_replication
         WHERE application_name IN ('tap_sub', 'walreceiver')
;
-- For binary upgrade, must preserve pg_type oid
SELECT pg_catalog.binary_upgrade_set_next_pg_type_oid('25676'::pg_catalog.oid)
;
SELECT typarray FROM pg_catalog.pg_type WHERE oid = '28926'::pg_catalog.oid
;
SELECT c2.relname, i.indisprimary, i.indisunique, i.indisclustered, i.indisvalid, pg_catalog.pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid, 0, true),
  pg_catalog.pg_get_constraintdef(con.oid, true), contype, condeferrable, condeferred, i.indisreplident, c2.reltablespace
FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c, pg_catalog.pg_class c2, pg_catalog.pg_index i
  LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_constraint con ON (conrelid = i.indrelid AND conindid = i.indexrelid AND contype IN ('p','u','x'))
WHERE c.oid = '35348' AND c.oid = i.indrelid AND i.indexrelid = c2.oid
ORDER BY i.indisprimary DESC, c2.relname
;
SELECT v.blkno, v.offnum, v.attnum, v.msg FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c, "amcheck_schema".verify_heapam(
relation := c.oid, on_error_stop := false, check_toast := true, skip := 'none'
) v WHERE c.oid = 17563 AND c.relpersistence != 't'
;

SELECT c2.relname, i.indisprimary, i.indisunique, i.indisclustered, i.indisvalid, pg_catalog.pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid, 0, true),
  pg_catalog.pg_get_constraintdef(con.oid, true), contype, condeferrable, condeferred, i.indisreplident, c2.reltablespace
FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c, pg_catalog.pg_class c2, pg_catalog.pg_index i
  LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_constraint con ON (conrelid = i.indrelid AND conindid = i.indexrelid AND contype IN ('p','u','x'))
WHERE c.oid = '39613' AND c.oid = i.indrelid AND i.indexrelid = c2.oid
ORDER BY i.indisprimary DESC, c2.relname
;
-- For binary upgrade, must preserve pg_class oids and relfilenodes
SELECT pg_catalog.binary_upgrade_set_next_heap_pg_class_oid('29299'::pg_catalog.oid)
;
SELECT x / 2
;

[METADATA] SELECT a.attname,
  pg_catalog.format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod),
  (SELECT pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(d.adbin, d.adrelid, true)
   FROM pg_catalog.pg_attrdef d
   WHERE d.adrelid = a.attrelid AND d.adnum = a.attnum AND a.atthasdef),
  a.attnotnull,
  (SELECT c.collname FROM pg_catalog.pg_collation c, pg_catalog.pg_type t
   WHERE c.oid = a.attcollation AND t.oid = a.atttypid AND a.attcollation <> t.typcollation) AS attcollation,
  a.attidentity,
  a.attgenerated,
  a.attstorage,
  CASE WHEN a.attstattarget=-1 THEN NULL ELSE a.attstattarget END AS attstattarget,
  pg_catalog.col_description(a.attrelid, a.attnum)
FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute a
WHERE a.attrelid = '22251' AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped
ORDER BY a.attnum
;
----------
[METADATA] SELECT c.oid::pg_catalog.regclass, c.relkind, inhdetachpending, pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(c.relpartbound, c.oid)
FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c, pg_catalog.pg_inherits i
WHERE c.oid = i.inhrelid AND i.inhparent = '26720'
ORDER BY pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(c.relpartbound, c.oid) = 'DEFAULT', c.oid::pg_catalog.regclass::pg_catalog.text
;
----------
[SELECT|PERFORMANCE] SELECT oid, stxrelid::pg_catalog.regclass, stxnamespace::pg_catalog.regnamespace::pg_catalog.text AS nsp, stxname,
pg_catalog.pg_get_statisticsobjdef_columns(oid) AS columns,
  'd' = any(stxkind) AS ndist_enabled,
  'f' = any(stxkind) AS deps_enabled,
  'm' = any(stxkind) AS mcv_enabled,
stxstattarget
FROM pg_catalog.pg_statistic_ext
WHERE stxrelid = '30955'
ORDER BY nsp, stxname
;
----------
[METADATA] SELECT pubname
     , NULL
     , NULL
FROM pg_catalog.pg_publication p
     JOIN pg_catalog.pg_publication_namespace pn ON p.oid = pn.pnpubid
     JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class pc ON pc.relnamespace = pn.pnnspid
WHERE pc.oid ='27192' and pg_catalog.pg_relation_is_publishable('27192')
UNION
SELECT pubname
     , pg_get_expr(pr.prqual, c.oid)
     , (CASE WHEN pr.prattrs IS NOT NULL THEN
         (SELECT string_agg(attname, ', ')
           FROM pg_catalog.generate_series(0, pg_catalog.array_upper(pr.prattrs::pg_catalog.int2[], 1)) s,
                pg_catalog.pg_attribute
          WHERE attrelid = pr.prrelid AND attnum = prattrs[s])
        ELSE NULL END) FROM pg_catalog.pg_publication p
     JOIN pg_catalog.pg_publication_rel pr ON p.oid = pr.prpubid
     JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class c ON c.oid = pr.prrelid
WHERE pr.prrelid = '27192'
UNION
SELECT pubname
     , NULL
     , NULL
FROM pg_catalog.pg_publication p
WHERE p.puballtables AND pg_catalog.pg_relation_is_publishable('27192')
ORDER BY 1
;
----------
[METADATA] SELECT a.attname,
  pg_catalog.format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod),
  (SELECT pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(d.adbin, d.adrelid, true)
   FROM pg_catalog.pg_attrdef d
   WHERE d.adrelid = a.attrelid AND d.adnum = a.attnum AND a.atthasdef),
  a.attnotnull,
  (SELECT c.collname FROM pg_catalog.pg_collation c, pg_catalog.pg_type t
   WHERE c.oid = a.attcollation AND t.oid = a.atttypid AND a.attcollation <> t.typcollation) AS attcollation,
  a.attidentity,
  a.attgenerated,
  a.attstorage,
  CASE WHEN a.attstattarget=-1 THEN NULL ELSE a.attstattarget END AS attstattarget,
  pg_catalog.col_description(a.attrelid, a.attnum)
FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute a
WHERE a.attrelid = '29436' AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped
ORDER BY a.attnum
;

  pg_catalog.pg_get_indexdef(a.attrelid, a.attnum, TRUE) AS indexdef
FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute a
WHERE a.attrelid = '42457' AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped
ORDER BY a.attnum

[METADATA] SELECT t.tgname, pg_catalog.pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid, true), t.tgenabled, t.tgisinternal,
  CASE WHEN t.tgparentid != 0 THEN
    (SELECT u.tgrelid::pg_catalog.regclass
     FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger AS u,
          pg_catalog.pg_partition_ancestors(t.tgrelid) WITH ORDINALITY AS a(relid, depth)
     WHERE u.tgname = t.tgname AND u.tgrelid = a.relid
           AND u.tgparentid = 0
     ORDER BY a.depth LIMIT 1)
  END AS parent
FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger t
WHERE t.tgrelid = '36670' AND (NOT t.tgisinternal OR (t.tgisinternal AND t.tgenabled = 'D'))
ORDER BY 1
;

[SELECT] SELECT d AS date, i AS interval,
       eval(format('date %L + interval %L', d, i)) AS plus,
       eval(format('date %L - interval %L', d, i)) AS minus
FROM (VALUES (date '-infinity'),
             (date '1995-08-06'),
             (date 'infinity')) AS t1(d),
     (VALUES (interval '-infinity'),
             (interval 'infinity')) AS t2(i)

[SELECT] -- For binary upgrade, must preserve pg_class oids
SELECT pg_catalog.binary_upgrade_set_next_heap_pg_class_oid('36731'::pg_catalog.oid)
;
----------
[METADATA] SELECT c.oid::pg_catalog.regclass
FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c, pg_catalog.pg_inherits i
WHERE c.oid = i.inhparent AND i.inhrelid = '31479'
  AND c.relkind != 'p' AND c.relkind != 'I'
ORDER BY inhseqno
;
----------
[PERFORMANCE] -- Don't remove SJ
EXPLAIN (COSTS OFF)
SELECT * FROM sj j1, sj j2 WHERE j1.b = j2.b AND (j1.a = 1 OR j2.a = 1)
;
----------
[METADATA] SELECT conname, conrelid::pg_catalog.regclass AS ontable,
       pg_catalog.pg_get_constraintdef(oid, true) AS condef
  FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint c
 WHERE confrelid IN (SELECT pg_catalog.pg_partition_ancestors('18137')
                     UNION ALL VALUES ('18137'::pg_catalog.regclass))
       AND contype = 'f' AND conparentid = 0
ORDER BY conname
;
----------
[SELECT] SELECT '42'::int_custom < '100'::int_custom AS lt_test
;
----------
[SELECT] SELECT pg_catalog.binary_upgrade_set_next_index_relfilenode('38803'::pg_catalog.oid)
;
----------
[SELECT] SELECT pg_catalog.binary_upgrade_set_next_toast_relfilenode('34346'::pg_catalog.oid)
;
----------
[METADATA] SELECT pg_catalog.pg_relation_size('public.loct2'::pg_catalog.regclass) / 8192
;
----------
[METADATA] SELECT conname, conrelid::pg_catalog.regclass AS ontable,
       pg_catalog.pg_get_constraintdef(oid, true) AS condef
  FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint c
 WHERE confrelid IN (SELECT pg_catalog.pg_partition_ancestors('35412')
                     UNION ALL VALUES ('35412'::pg_catalog.regclass))
       AND contype = 'f' AND conparentid = 0
ORDER BY conname
;
----------
[METADATA] SELECT c.relchecks, c.relkind, c.relhasindex, c.relhasrules, c.relhastriggers, c.relrowsecurity, c.relforcerowsecurity, false AS relhasoids, c.relispartition, '', c.reltablespace, CASE WHEN c.reloftype = 0 THEN '' ELSE c.reloftype::pg_catalog.regtype::pg_catalog.text END, c.relpersistence, c.relreplident, am.amname
FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c
 LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class tc ON (c.reltoastrelid = tc.oid)
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_am am ON (c.relam = am.oid)
WHERE c.oid = '30704'
;
----------
[SELECT] select 'bbc' ~ '^([bc])\1*$' as f
;
----------
[METADATA] SELECT typarray FROM pg_catalog.pg_type WHERE oid = '35672'::pg_catalog.oid
;
----------
[METADATA] SELECT a.attname,
  pg_catalog.format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod),
  (SELECT pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(d.adbin, d.adrelid, true)
   FROM pg_catalog.pg_attrdef d
   WHERE d.adrelid = a.attrelid AND d.adnum = a.attnum AND a.atthasdef),
  a.attnotnull,
  (SELECT c.collname FROM pg_catalog.pg_collation c, pg_catalog.pg_type t
   WHERE c.oid = a.attcollation AND t.oid = a.atttypid AND a.attcollation <> t.typcollation) AS attcollation,
  a.attidentity,
  a.attgenerated
FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute a
WHERE a.attrelid = '46215' AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped
ORDER BY a.attnum
;
----------
[SELECT] SELECT count(*) FROM tbl_cs_fail
;
----------
[SELECT] -- For binary upgrade, must preserve pg_type oid
SELECT pg_catalog.binary_upgrade_set_next_pg_type_oid('35055'::pg_catalog.oid)
;
----------
[METADATA] SELECT a.attname,
  pg_catalog.format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod),
  CASE WHEN a.attnum <= (SELECT i.indnkeyatts FROM pg_catalog.pg_index i WHERE i.indexrelid = '16533') THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS is_key,
  pg_catalog.pg_get_indexdef(a.attrelid, a.attnum, TRUE) AS indexdef
FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute a
WHERE a.attrelid = '16533' AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped
ORDER BY a.attnum
;

[METADATA] SELECT c2.relname, i.indisprimary, i.indisunique, i.indisclustered, i.indisvalid, pg_catalog.pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid, 0, true),
  pg_catalog.pg_get_constraintdef(con.oid, true), contype, condeferrable, condeferred, i.indisreplident, c2.reltablespace
FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c, pg_catalog.pg_class c2, pg_catalog.pg_index i
  LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_constraint con ON (conrelid = i.indrelid AND conindid = i.indexrelid AND contype IN ('p','u','x'))
WHERE c.oid = '35348' AND c.oid = i.indrelid AND i.indexrelid = c2.oid
ORDER BY i.indisprimary DESC, c2.relname
;
